name: bale-mcp
title: Bale Bot
description: Private, local Bale bot for agents: read, search and answer messages, ask and wait, files.

env.name: BALE_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Bot token from @botfather in Bale (https://ble.ir/botfather).

env.name: BALE_ALLOWED_CHATS
env.description: Comma-separated chat ids or @usernames the bot may read and message; all other chats are ignored. Recommended.

env.name: BALE_MCP_DB
env.description: Local message history file (default ~/.bale-mcp/messages.db); ':memory:' keeps nothing on disk.

env.name: BALE_MCP_PROXY
env.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for every request; system proxy settings are ignored.

tools.name: bot_get_me
tools.title: Bot: who am I
tools.summary: Check BALE_BOT_TOKEN and show the bot's id, username and name. Use first to confirm the bot works.

tools.name: bot_get_chat
tools.title: Bot: chat info
tools.summary: Get a chat's type, title or name, username and description, as seen by the bot.

tools.name: bot_get_webhook_info
tools.title: Bot: webhook status
tools.summary: Show whether a webhook is set (url empty = the reading tools work), pending updates and the last error.

tools.name: bot_send_message
tools.title: Bot: send message
tools.summary: Send a text message from the bot. Sends a real message. Confirm recipient and text with the user before calling.

tools.name: bot_send_file
tools.title: Bot: send file
tools.summary: Send a photo, document, video, audio or voice file from the bot. Sends a real message. Confirm recipient and file with the user before calling.

tools.name: bot_edit_message
tools.title: Bot: edit message
tools.summary: Replace the text of a message the bot sent earlier. Changes a real message. Confirm with the user before calling.

tools.name: bot_delete_message
tools.title: Bot: delete message
tools.summary: Delete a message in a chat where the bot may delete it (its own messages, or as admin). Cannot be undone; confirm with the user first.

tools.name: bot_get_new_messages
tools.title: Bot: new messages
tools.summary: Get messages people sent the bot since the last check, from all chats, oldest first, and mark them read.

tools.name: bot_list_chats
tools.title: Bot: list chats
tools.summary: List the chats this bot has talked in, newest first, with unread count and last message. Use to find chat ids.

tools.name: bot_read_chat
tools.title: Bot: read chat
tools.summary: Show a chat's recent messages in both directions, oldest first, and mark the chat read.

tools.name: bot_search_messages
tools.title: Bot: search messages
tools.summary: Search stored messages by text, newest first. Arabic and Persian yeh/kaf, Persian and Latin digits,

tools.name: bot_wait_for_reply
tools.title: Bot: wait for reply
tools.summary: Wait until someone writes in a chat or presses a button, then return the new messages (marked read).

tools.name: bot_download_file
tools.title: Bot: download file
tools.summary: Download a file someone sent the bot to this computer (max 20 MB) and return its local path.

name: swapwallet-mcp
title: SwapWallet
description: Crypto wallet: balances, P&L, history. Swaps, transfers and withdrawals need Telegram approval.

tools.name: get_total_balance
tools.title: Total balance
tools.summary: The user's total portfolio value plus a per-token breakdown of every non-zero holding.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Balance of specific coins
tools.summary: Balance and value of the given tokens only.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.title: Account details
tools.summary: The user's profile, verification level and account settings.

tools.name: get_deposit_address
tools.title: Deposit address
tools.summary: The user's deposit address for a token on a network, creating one if needed.

tools.name: get_profit_and_loss
tools.title: Profit and loss
tools.summary: Realized and unrealized profit and loss, for all assets or the given tokens.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.title: Transaction history
tools.summary: Recent deposits, withdrawals, transfers and trades, newest first.

tools.name: get_contacts
tools.title: Saved contacts
tools.summary: The user's saved SwapWallet contacts, ten per page.

tools.name: get_ibans
tools.title: Verified IBANs
tools.summary: The user's verified bank accounts, usable as a Rial withdrawal destination.

tools.name: get_action_request
tools.title: Check an approval request
tools.summary: The current status of a request created by one of the request_* tools: PENDING while the user has not answered, then EXECUTED, REJECTED, EXPIRED or FAILED.

tools.name: request_swap
tools.title: Request a swap
tools.summary: Prices a swap between two tokens and sends it to the user's Telegram for approval.

tools.name: request_transfer
tools.title: Request a transfer to another user
tools.summary: Prepares a transfer to another SwapWallet user and sends it to the user's Telegram for approval.

tools.name: request_crypto_withdraw
tools.title: Request a crypto withdrawal
tools.summary: Prepares a crypto withdrawal and sends it to the user's Telegram for approval.

tools.name: request_fiat_withdraw
tools.title: Request a Rial withdrawal
tools.summary: Prepares a Rial (IRT) withdrawal to one of the user's verified IBANs and sends it to their Telegram for approval.
